---
name: Friction / feedback
about: Something in dpcli slowed agents or developers down
labels: feedback
---

**What hurt** (one or two sentences, anonymized — no project names, paths or people)

**How often** — times seen, in how many tasks / projects

**Command(s) involved** — e.g. `accept --dry`, `plan`, `task show`

**Proposed change** — what dpcli should do instead

**How to verify** — the test or check that would prove it is fixed
